name: jev-search
title: Jev Search
description: Progressive natural-language search of local text files with Jev
author: kazuhide

commands.name: search-local
commands.title: Search Local Files
commands.description: 自然言語でsrc・Downloads・マイドライブ・iCloudの文書をローカル検索

preferences.name: nodePath
preferences.title: Node.js Path
preferences.description: Optional path to Node.js for the local index process. Detected automatically when omitted.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Files with Jev
commands.description: Find text files using natural language and progressive excerpt evaluation

preferences.name: root
preferences.title: Search Directory
preferences.description: Used only by Search Files with Jev. Cloud evaluation is restricted to this directory.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: TypeSafe API Key
preferences.description: Optional: without a key, search stays local. Excerpts are sent to TypeSafe when a key is configured.

preferences.name: envFile
preferences.title: API Key File
preferences.description: Optional .env file containing TYPESAFE_API_KEY. The password preference takes precedence.
